data.text:
LIBRENG DOXYCYCLINE SA MAYNILA

Magbibigay ng libreng doxycycline ang Manila Health Department sa health centers sa lungsod ngayong Lunes, Nov. 10, bilang proteksyon sa mga lumusong sa baha kasunod ng malakas na pag-ulang dala ng Bagyong #UwanPH.

Kinakailangan munang magpakonsulta sa health personnel para mabigyan ng tamang dosage ng nasabing gamot.

📷: Manila Health Department

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 10 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 10 November 2025(Monday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga, Bataan, Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Panukulan, Polillo, Burdeos).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Patnanungan, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
